Thomas

additional_info.body:
Activity need to undertaken in 6:30 - 10:30 am IST
We need to update the all Charger (7 chargers as mentioned in prior notes, You can search equans in SCB) to v6.0.11.
Charger are on different FWs, Next FW rollout have been done.
We need to activate update and then download next FW and activate. Finally bring all 7 chargers to the v6.0.11.
And after FW updated to latest FW, We need to enable the Autocharge on all 7 Chargers.
